newsitem.title: USA: Integral Systems wins EchoStar deal.
newsitem.headline: Integral Systems wins EchoStar deal.

text.p: Integral Systems Inc said Friday it won a contract from EchoStar Communications Corp to provide dual satellite control centers for the EchoStar-III satellite.
The amount of the contract was not disclosed.
Integral said the contract was its first with EchoStar, a growing U.S. direct-broadcast satellite service and was its first direct-to-home satellite venture.
The EchoStar III Satellite, the third from EschoStar to provide direct-to-home television service, will be launched in September. Its builder is Lockheed Martin Corp.
Integral Systems provides satellite ground systems and has supported over 70 satellite missions for communications, science, meteorological and earth resource applications.
